exactNativeGatewayBlockerAnalysis.brokerWorkerTransport: LocalJobBrokerTransport spawns arena-job-broker (options.executable) and requires that connecting worker clients authenticate with SO_PEERCRED peer.uid == options.workerUid (arena-supervisor UID 997).

exactNativeGatewayBlockerAnalysis.operatorGrantRequirement: To connect the native queue worker in production, the operator must either provision a systemd service unit (e.g., oantuti-worker.service running as arena-supervisor) or extend sudoers rules to permit running arena-worker as arena-supervisor. This is an administrative infrastructure provisioning requirement, not a software compilation defect.
